_help: Profile pages at web3.toys/@handle (js/page-view.js, js/page-edit.js, supabase/019_pages.sql). Edit the wording freely. reserved: handles nobody can use (every folder of the site is added automatically by the checks; keep the same list in 019_pages.sql, a test compares them). flagWords: words that send a page to your review when an owner uses them (no token promotion); keep the same list in 019_pages.sql. pro: what Pro adds, how long each purchase turns it on (months), and the yearly plan (switched off until on is true).

project.label: Project
project.line: A web3 product, protocol or community. Every project is vetted before its page goes live.

creator.label: Creator
creator.line: You make web3 content: posts, videos, threads, newsletters. Free forever.

personality.label: Personality
personality.line: A known name in web3: founder, builder, researcher, investor.

copy.notClaimedLine: web3.toys made this page from public information. Is this your project?
copy.claimHow: Log in with the project's X account (@{handle}) to claim it. Nothing is posted to X.
copy.claimed: It's yours! You are now the owner of this page.
copy.mismatch: You are logged in with X as @{you}, but this page belongs to @{handle}. Log out and log in with @{handle}, or request a page for your own account.
copy.noX: Claiming needs Log in with X, so we can check you own @{handle}.
copy.taken: This page already has an owner. If you think that's wrong, report it and we will look.
reportReasons: Promotes a token or a sale
copy.reportThanks: Thanks. Our team will look at it.
copy.requestTitle: Request a page for a project
copy.requestLine: We vet every project first. Tell us about it and we will make its page; the team can then claim it with the project's X account.
copy.reviewNote: Your page is waiting for our review. We check every new page before it goes live, usually within 2 working days.
copy.draftNote: Only you can see this draft. Send it for review when you're ready.
copy.rejectedNote: We could not publish this page yet. See the note below, change it and send it again.
copy.suspendedNote: This page is paused while we look into it. Questions? Use the Contact page.
rules: No token promotion: no presales, airdrops, price talk or calls to buy.
Only claim what is yours. Pages about people are made only by those people.
Links must be safe. We remove pages that link to scams.

features: Export of fans who agreed to share
Embed code for your custom toy
No other sponsors on your page
